summary: Sprott Inc., a Canadian asset manager, filed a Form 6-K with interim financial statements, MD&A, CEO/CFO certifications, and a press release for Q2 2026. The filing reports AUM of $55.6 billion as of June 30, 2026, down 15% from the prior quarter, with net redemptions of $377 million in Q2, net income of $34.3 million ($1.33 per share), and adjusted EBITDA of $50.8 million. This is a routine quarterly earnings disclosure by a foreign private issuer, containing no special-situation transaction such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or other corporate event. The filing is incorporated by reference into an existing S-8 registration statement. No deal terms or strategic actions are announced. What to watch: ongoing precious metals market volatility affecting AUM and fund flows.
